content.summary: Shared AppLayout component with sidebar navigation and topnav. Sidebar items filtered by user role. Role-based automatic landing redirect after login. Logout accessible from topnav.

user_stories.want: to land on the POS screen immediately after login
user_stories.so_that: I don't have to navigate manually to do my job

user_stories.want: to land on the Invoices list after login
user_stories.so_that: my primary workspace is always the first thing I see

user_stories.want: a consistent sidebar that shows only the screens relevant to my role
user_stories.so_that: I am not confused by links I cannot use
I can securely end my session

business_rules: BR-NAV-01: A user whose role has no access to a route receives a 403 page, not a silent redirect
BR-NAV-02: Sidebar nav items are driven by user.role from Zustand auth store — no API call needed
BR-NAV-03: Active route is highlighted in sidebar
BR-NAV-04: Logout clears Zustand store + localStorage + redirects to /login

tasks.title: Role-based landing redirect in RequireAuth guard
Wrap all protected routes in AppLayout

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: nav-layout feature created. Sprint 4 P1. Addresses navigation gap identified after Sprint 3 frontend delivery.
